### [`cold_start`](../../../../src/init/cold_start.asm#L6) `$8000`

*routine*

Entry of the program. Unpacks the charset and the sprites, then starts the game init at $81ff.

- **Calls:** [`copy_graphics`](copy_graphics.md#copy_graphics)
